verses.text: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
“How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
lines: “How long will you speak these things?
Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

verses.text: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
lines: Does God pervert justice?
Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

verses.text: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
lines: If your children have sinned against him,
he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

verses.text: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
lines: If you want to seek God diligently,
make your supplication to the Almighty.

verses.text: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
lines: If you were pure and upright,
surely now he would awaken for you,
and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

verses.text: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
lines: Though your beginning was small,
yet your latter end would greatly increase.

verses.text: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
lines: “Please inquire of past generations.
Find out about the learning of their fathers.

verses.text: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
lines: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing,
because our days on earth are a shadow.)

verses.text: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
lines: Shall they not teach you, tell you,
and utter words out of their heart?

verses.text: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
lines: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire?
Can the rushes grow without water?

verses.text: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
lines: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down,
it withers before any other reed.

verses.text: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
lines: So are the paths of all who forget God.
The hope of the godless man will perish,

verses.text: Whose confidence will break apart, Whose trust is a spider’s web.
lines: Whose confidence will break apart,
Whose trust is a spider’s web.

verses.text: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
lines: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand.
He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

verses.text: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
lines: He is green before the sun.
His shoots go out along his garden.

verses.text: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
lines: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile.
He sees the place of stones.

verses.text: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
lines: If he is destroyed from his place,
then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

verses.text: Behold, this is the joy of his way: out of the earth, others will spring.
lines: Behold, this is the joy of his way:
out of the earth, others will spring.

verses.text: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
lines: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man,
neither will he uphold the evildoers.

verses.text: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
lines: He will still fill your mouth with laughter,
your lips with shouting.

verses.text: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
lines: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame.
The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
